messages.subject: Starting Up Problem
parts:
Hi Folks,

One of my students can't get deducer running on his Windows 10 laptop. Any suggestions?

Loading required package: JGR
Loading required package: rJava
Loading required package: JavaGD
Loading required package: iplots
starting httpd help server ... done
Loading required package: DeducerExtras
Loading required package: Deducer
Loading required package: ggplot2

Error in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]) : 
  there is no package called 'Rcpp'

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Starting Up Problem
parts:
Somehow the Rcpp package didn't get installed or got removed. This should never happen unless the package directory was manually removed. Have you tried

install.packages("Rcpp")


ian
